supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Final FY2024 CMS-64 rows total $7,004,651,458 for Oklahoma's federal Medicaid share. CMS does not publicly release category-of-service quarters, so any annual row still above $10B is an explicit public disclosure ceiling rather than an invented split. Medicaid is a major component of public welfare, but this federal-share boundary is supplemental—not additive—to the broader Census state-government function.

supplementalBreakdowns.title: Oklahoma SFY2024 OHCA expenditures by age and non-age-specific status
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: Oklahoma Health Care Authority's SFY2024 annual-report appendix allocates $10.327062611B of expenditures among three mutually exclusive age groups and non-age-specific payments. The four published values reconcile exactly to the report's expenditure control, and every row is below $10B. OHCA describes financial-statement data as actual cash expenditure reported to the Office of State Finance. This Medicaid-agency view is supplemental—not additive—to Census's broader public-welfare function or federal-fiscal-year CMS-64 reporting.
